name: Portland
local_rules: Portland parking citations are adjudicated by the Multnomah County Circuit Court. Submitting a written explanation is a 'Waiver of Hearing' — you are consenting to the judge's decision based on your documents alone. Include the 10-character citation number (usually starts with 'HA'). For expired registration violations, the court offers a standardized fine reduction (e.g., down to $20) if you include proof of correction and photos of the new stickers. Portland State University (PSU) citations are separate; avoid mailing city court for campus-specific tickets unless the ticket header explicitly directs you there.

confirmation_note: Portland parking citations are adjudicated by the Multnomah County Circuit Court. You have 60 days from issuance to submit your written explanation — one of the most generous windows in the country, but don't let it fool you: processing times can take 6 to 12 months. Important: Submitting a written explanation is a 'Waiver of Hearing' — you are consenting to the judge's decision based on your documents alone. Include the 10-character citation number (usually starts with 'HA'). If the violation is for expired registration, the court offers a standardized fine reduction (e.g., down to $20) if you include proof of correction and photos of the new stickers in your Appeal Kit. Note: Portland State University (PSU) citations are separate; avoid mailing city court for campus-specific tickets unless the ticket header explicitly directs you there.

mail_acceptance_policy.official_excerpt: OPTION 2 – Send a written explanation: Insert in the yellow citation envelope a separate written explanation as to why you are contesting the citation. You should include any documents you would like the judge to review with your explanation. Your written explanation is a waiver of your right to a court hearing and consent to any judgment rendered. Mail to: Multnomah County Circuit Court, Parking Citation Office, P.O. Box 78, Portland, OR 97207.

legal_declarations.heading: ⚖️ Legal Declaration & Waiver of Oral Hearing
legal_declarations.template: Pursuant to Multnomah County Circuit Court rules, I am submitting this written explanation as my formal response to the parking citation {citation_number}. I explicitly understand and agree that this written explanation serves as a complete waiver of my right to an oral court hearing and constitutes my explicit consent to any judgment entered by the court based on this review. I further declare under penalty of perjury that the statements provided herein are true and accurate to the best of my knowledge.
